template.id: S4RC1 EPS per-point review template c3v001 (Claude3 builder)
how_to_fill: Copy the 'bindings' block of the point's EPS_REVIEW_REQUEST_<key16>.json exactly (numeric_ref pin, point_sha256, custody_sha256).
Work through REVIEWER_CHECKLIST_C3V001.md section E and record each item in checklist_results.
Set verdict to APPROVED only if every E item holds; otherwise write REJECTED with findings. Never edit the numeric record.
Write the review OUTSIDE the runner output root (the runner refuses reviews inside it), by exclusive create, in the reviewer lane's own folder.
Give root the review path and its sha256 from bytes; root passes them to adapt-eps (--review, --approved-review-sha256, --approved-signer-lane).
Delete this 'template' block before signing. Any '<FILL' string or the TEMPLATE_NOT_A_REVIEW verdict makes the runner refuse the file.

numeric_ref.path: <FILL: exact EPS_NUMERIC_<key16>.json path from STAGE_EPS record>

accepts_registered_numerical_estimate_no: <FILL: true only after the checklist; the EPS values are search lower bounds on the continuous supremum>
reviewer_lane: <FILL: a root-approved signer lane, not the CP-1 operator lane and not Codex2 (producer author)>
